program.name: Athlete Circuits
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Athletic training with no equipment: jumps, a bodyweight circuit and balance.
program.about: Athletic training with nothing but the floor. Jumps first, then a bodyweight circuit of single-leg work, push-ups and floor pulls, then balance. The two days change the jumps and the circuit. Good for travel, or for teams with no gym. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
